http/internal/http2_sending#

The send side of HTTP/2 flow control: DATA cut to the windows and frame size, with credit reserved before a frame is queued and spent when it is written.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The send side of HTTP/2 flow control: DATA cut to the windows and frame size, with credit reserved before a frame is queued and spent when it is written.

Internal to the http modules; programs do not import it.

Public API#

object Http2DataScheduler#

object Http2DataScheduler

Windows reflect physical starts; reservations are separate, so an unsent frame cannot hide overflow or spend credit when its producer is cancelled.
